title: [Widget proposal]: toggle button ('boolean' facet)
body:
I would like to have a widget able to toggle a single facet value.

![2015-08-04-114907_276x214_scrot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/9058103/fdab6ad6-3a9e-11e5-8f02-eca110965466.png)

what do you think?

comments.body: It could make sense for boolean filtering, but I'm not very familiar with any search interface with such UX -> where is that screenshot coming from?
From a POC (the same hierarchical POC we did). The client had an index with a clear separation between selling items and sold items (a bit like searching for sold properties versus to buy properties)
OK, I would put it as low priority then; I think it's not very common on the web but could make a lot of sense on mobile. Here is what Amazon do:
Yes, on mobile makes sense. This widget is low priority of course because not present in the instant search demo
now focusing on #41, let's revisit this use case later on
